name: comp-479
title: Sortable Columns Table
blurb: Sortable table with draggable column resizers and keyboard controls.
description: Data table where columns are sortable with chevron indicators and resizable by dragging handles between headers. Supports keyboard navigation (Enter/Space for sorting) with aria-sort attributes.
use_when: Users need to customize table layout and sort multiple columns interactively.
avoid_when: Data is dynamic with backend sorting — sorting is client-side only.
a11y: Sort headers are keyboard-accessible with aria-sort attributes. Resize handles are touch-enabled with visual feedback.
